body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Stealth Acoustics has just unveiled the model B22 compact subwoofer as the 6th in its line of completely invisible audio solutions. The B22 was designed specifically to work in conjunction with the ever-popular FX6, FX8 and AX3 to create a more full-range and dynamic listening experience in the home, office, or anywhere distributed audio systems are desired all while remaining completely invisible.

The B22 uses an eight inch woofer driver mounted in the popular 22" frame, giving the speaker the compact footprint of the FX8 and the tooth-rattling capability of the B1630. With frequency range extending down to 25 Hz, this speaker will be a tremendous compliment to the FX6 and the FX8 when used as a distributed audio system. Re¬tail priced at $500 per pair this speaker has the potential to save dealers time and money on the installation, while helping to provide jaw-dropping sound from every room in the home.

"The B22 is a great compli¬ment to any of our current speak¬ers. It's going to give our deal¬ers a lot more freedom when it comes to designing whole house audio. Roughly half the weight and size of our current sub - the B1630, it will be easier to install, and power. This is going to help take the sound of our most popu¬lar distributed audio speakers (the FX6s and FX8s) to the next level." - Paul Hagman, President of Stealth Acoustics

Stealth Acoustic products are distributed world-wide by our directly franchised value added resellers, custom install¬ers and distributors. Please contact Stealth Acoustics for pricing and additional information on all our products.
